headline: AGS Transact Technologies Limited: CIRP Intimation to NSE/BSE
sum: AGS Transact Technologies Limited has initiated a Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process, with the company intimating the stock exchanges (NSE and BSE) of the 14th Committee of Creditors meeting. The filing indicates formal entry into the statutory CIRP framework under IBC 2016.
detail: AGS Transact Technologies Limited, a BSE and NSE-listed entity, has formally notified the exchanges of its Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process and convened the 14th Committee of Creditors meeting. The notice is filed in compliance with Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR 2015 and IBC disclosure obligations. The stage and appointment of an insolvency professional, along with CoC deliberations, are proceeding; the resolution process and outcome remain pending.
